reasoning_content: Keycloak routing works. Valhalla and streamlet — 404 on `/` might be expected since they don't serve a root path. Let me check valhalla /status and streamlet endpoints. Actually valhalla.localhost -> 404 for `/`. Valhalla health is at /status. Let me check.

action.command: cd /workspace && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "valhalla/status -> %{http_code}\n" -H "Host: valhalla.localhost" http://localhost:3000/status --max-time 10; curl -s -H "Host: valhalla.localhost" http://localhost:3000/status --max-time 10 | head -c 100; echo; docker exec workspace-streamlet-1 wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null | head -c 200; echo; echo "=== traefik routers ==="; docker exec workspace-reverse-proxy-1 wget -qO- http://localhost:8080/api/http/routers 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; [print(r['name'], r['entryPoints'], r['status']) for r in json.load(sys.stdin)]"
